first_25.title: Freeze the complete search and evidence contract
first_25.what_runs: Freeze every recipe, arm, side, pair, horizon, seed, stopping rule and owner-gated branch before runs. Use only 2025-08-11 through 2026-07-31. Nest all tuning and final recipe selection; register the two full-search nulls and cumulative attempted family.
first_25.kill_rule: An unregistered trial or outer-label-based setting defeats the frozen-search claim.
first_25.why_now: Every added trial changes the search burden.

first_25.title: Finish routing reports through strict certification
first_25.what_runs: Exercise synthetic results with 1, 11, 12 and 15 clearing paths, incomplete runs and missing paths. Require all 15 evaluated, at least 12 with 25 trades and win rate 0.541, and path p10 at least 0.541. Repair the batch runner's legacy note.
first_25.kill_rule: Any incomplete or under-supported fixture certifying fails the guard.
first_25.why_now: The remaining reporting inconsistency can misstate progress.

first_25.title: Reject empty support and degenerate gate outputs
first_25.what_runs: Replay synthetic empty validation, excluded rows scored 0.5, zero thresholds, missing diagnostics and zero feature-gain cases. Compare supported-case thresholds and trade indices with the unchanged incumbent scorer.
first_25.kill_rule: Stop if excluded rows trade, empty support crashes or thresholds use test outcomes.
first_25.why_now: Cached policy testing needs explicit masks and support failures.

first_25.title: Capture exact execution and split references
first_25.what_runs: Use the approved e1t development USDJPY 15-minute NY path-one configuration, seed 0. Capture ordered rows, predictions, threshold, trades and phase timings; compare unchanged serial execution and the staged parallel harness, then extend to affected paths.
first_25.kill_rule: Any mismatch rejects exact execution equivalence; preserve separately versioned statistical changes.
first_25.cost: At most 20 shared reference fits; build S
first_25.why_now: Execution changes need an exact reference before shared reuse.

first_25.title: Check causal prefixes and outcome maturity
first_25.what_runs: Check 100 deterministic development prefixes and session/fold boundaries on all seven pairs. Append later observations and require issued features unchanged. Plant future-filled features and premature feedback; use decision plus one second plus horizon for expiry.
first_25.kill_rule: Any unexplained prefix, lineage or maturity violation invalidates affected evidence.
first_25.why_now: This guards new path features and every adaptive consumer.

first_25.title: Build the complete nested selector
first_25.what_runs: At 15 and 30 minutes on AUDUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, NZDUSD, USDCAD, USDCHF, USDJPY, compare four single models, equal pooling, a shrunk stack, side coverage and abstention. Use three ordered inner windows, separate calibration and quantile rows, then all 15 paths.
first_25.kill_rule: Outer outcomes must influence no selection; no positive forward per-offer gain ends selector promotion.
first_25.cost: Up to 4,256 parent fits shared with E-006; build L
first_25.why_now: The entire procedure needs selection inside each outer training fold.

first_25.title: Reuse raw arrays with exact eligibility
first_25.what_runs: On the seven approved development pair datasets, compare uncached loading with persistent raw arrays for all-feature, own-feature and compact schemas at 15 and 30 minutes. Recompute each schema's eligibility; compare rows, values, masks and split indices.
first_25.kill_rule: Reject any changed eligible row or bit; defer persistence if loading takes under 5% of runtime.
first_25.why_now: Avoid repeated loading without silently changing evaluation populations.

first_25.title: Populate the complete reusable prediction cache
first_25.what_runs: Cache LightGBM, logistic, Nyström and extra-trees at 15/30 minutes on AUDUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, NZDUSD, USDCAD, USDCHF, USDJPY. Keep raw validation, member, inner, calibration and test predictions, masks and maturity. Replay the unchanged policy on three paths.
first_25.kill_rule: Any cache collision, role contamination or changed threshold/trade list rejects the cache.
first_25.cost: 1,064 final parent fits, included in E-014; build L
first_25.why_now: Existing post-gate test dumps cannot support the proposed replays.

first_25.title: Build synchronized daily evidence
first_25.what_runs: From cached 15/30-minute policies, reconstruct first-come nonoverlapping contracts and unique forward issues for all seven pairs. Aggregate daily wins, counts, offers and paired surplus over 0.541. Jointly resample daily vectors 9,999 times in mean-five-day blocks.
first_25.kill_rule: Unreconciled counts or treating repeated CPCV outcomes as independent fails the evidence table.
first_25.why_now: Path reuse must not masquerade as additional independent history.

first_25.title: Measure support and detectable effect sizes
first_25.what_runs: For every seven-pair 15/30-minute baseline key, count distinct contracts, days and overlap episodes. Calculate optimistic power at true win rates 0.551, 0.561 and 0.581 against 0.541; add 1,000 dependent daily simulations with the frozen family correction.
first_25.kill_rule: Defer expensive small-effect confirmation when even optimistic power is below 80%.
first_25.why_now: This prevents spending on configurations that cannot demonstrate their claimed lift.

first_25.title: Calibrate the joint search-wide inference guard
first_25.what_runs: Use the synchronized daily panel for every attempted candidate and key. Freeze five-day blocks, one/ten-day sensitivities, 0.025 absolute and 0.025 relative error budgets. Check duplicate-column invariance and planted effects before trials; register full refit confirmation.
first_25.kill_rule: No promotion unless simultaneous lower win rate exceeds 0.541 and adjusted relative p is at most 0.025.
first_25.why_now: A raw certificate after hundreds of trials is weak evidence by itself.

first_25.title: Integrate reliable global resource accounting
first_25.what_runs: Use synthetic jobs to inject child failure, duplicate destinations and competing queue owners. Enforce one completion per job, nonzero batch failure, a shared CPU budget for jobs and path workers, and one GPU trainer. Reuse measured two-thread throughput.
first_25.kill_rule: Any lost failure, duplicate completion or oversubscribed resource budget rejects the scheduler.
first_25.why_now: Parallel paths must not compete with an independent unbounded queue.

first_25.title: Accept the staged exact parallel path harness
first_25.what_runs: Integrate the already staged harness using its exact stored comparisons. Preserve serial split planning, validation draws, ordered subsampling and result merge order, including an all-hours case. Use the measured eight-worker schedule within the global resource limit.
first_25.kill_rule: Any changed index order, probability or accumulated gain rejects exactness.
first_25.cost: 0 new fits if stored fixtures suffice; build S
first_25.why_now: The throughput improvement is already measured; integration unlocks later fits.

first_25.title: Audit participation and concentration on cached streams
first_25.what_runs: For cached seven-pair 15/30-minute controls, report eligible offers, abstentions, failures, strict wins and per-offer surplus. Add validation-matched hour/volatility random rejection controls, monthly utility and leave-one-week-out influence; bound unknown selected outcomes.
first_25.kill_rule: No gate-benefit claim with nonpositive paired forward surplus or adverse unknown-outcome bounds.
first_25.why_now: A selected win-rate increase can hide lost participation or one influential episode.

first_25.title: Verify deterministic early failure stopping
first_25.what_runs: Replay complete cached runs in original path order. Stop only after both sides each have four paths failing count or 0.541 win rate; mark incomplete. Resume one run and restore all 15 paths plus four forward fits exactly.
first_25.kill_rule: No potentially passing side may be stopped; resumed results must reproduce the complete reference.
first_25.why_now: This saves fits on the expected large null majority.

first_25.title: Select supported separate side coverages
first_25.what_runs: Replay all seven pairs at 15/30 minutes. Compare side coverages 0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 0.03, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.30 against the incumbent pooled 3% policy. Select on three inner blocks with 25 trades per block and calendar-based uncertainty; freeze thresholds before tests.
first_25.kill_rule: Stop without supported inner p10-proxy improvement of 0.005; never match counts using outer outcomes.
first_25.why_now: The shared absolute-confidence threshold can allocate the two sides poorly.

first_25.title: Discount fixed direction scores by learned tie risk
first_25.what_runs: At 15 minutes on AUDUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, NZDUSD, USDCAD, USDCHF, USDJPY, freeze Nyström moved-sign scores. Fit tie logistic C=0.05 on RV, activity, freshness and clock. Compare strict-side scores with constant tie discount at validation-matched participation.
first_25.kill_rule: Skip if selected ties cannot yield 0.005 lift; require tie Brier skill and 0.005 inner tail-win gain.
first_25.cost: 21 small screen fits; confirmation within stage cap; build S
first_25.why_now: Ties are real losses omitted from current model fitting and threshold populations.

first_25.title: Compare tie-inclusive targets on the same inputs
first_25.what_runs: At 15 minutes on AUDUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, NZDUSD, USDCAD, USDCHF, USDJPY, compare moved-only logistic, three-class ridge and two strict heads at penalty 0.01. Add fixed freshness and five-bin ablations, at most six recipes. Calibrate native strict-side scores on all outcomes.
first_25.kill_rule: Stop without 0.005 matched-support inner tail-win lift over moved-only training; exact ties remain losses.
first_25.cost: At most 126 small screen fits; build M
first_25.why_now: This separates better event supervision from merely discounting fixed forecasts.

first_25.title: Recover tuning rows for the final estimator
first_25.what_runs: At 15 minutes on all seven pairs, use chronological fit/tune/map/threshold fractions 60/15/10/15 with horizon gaps. For logistic C=0.05 and fixed LightGBM, compare fitting on the first 60% with refitting preprocessing and model on the first 75%; keep later roles independent.
first_25.kill_rule: Stop if no rows can be recovered or three inner walks improve neither strict Brier nor matched tail wins.
first_25.why_now: The incumbent leaves selection rows out of the final fit.

first_25.title: Add the missing raw minute-path linear control
first_25.what_runs: At 15/30 minutes on AUDUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, NZDUSD, USDCAD, USDCHF, USDJPY, compare logistic C=0.05 on 66 features against those features plus 128 context-RMS-normalized own-minute returns clipped to [-8,8]. Use identical eligible rows and independent threshold calibration.
first_25.kill_rule: Stop if inner tail lift is nonpositive; record AUC separately and do not enlarge the lag grid.
first_25.why_now: This is the cheapest test of whether bar summaries discard signed path information.

first_25.title: Test pending peer shocks with quote freshness
first_25.what_runs: At 15 minutes on EURUSD, USDCAD, USDCHF, add normalized 15/60-second peer-median-minus-target moves and target change-age interactions to logistic C=0.05. Require packet age at most 2 seconds and four fresh agreeing peers. Compare the matched baseline and a fixed 5-second entry delay.
first_25.kill_rule: Kill below 0.01 median inner tail lift, fewer than two improving walks or loss under delayed entry.
first_25.cost: At most 54 screen fits including delay controls; build M
first_25.why_now: A currently pending peer adjustment differs from already completed quote bursts.

first_25.title: Test within-minute order beyond bar endpoints
first_25.what_runs: At 15 minutes on EURUSD, USDCAD, USDCHF, append first/last-20-second return contrasts, extrema order, signed waiting time and run states to logistic C=0.05. Compare baseline and deterministic interior-second permutation preserving minute endpoints on three inner walks.
first_25.kill_rule: Kill below 75 selected screening trades, 0.005 tail lift or failure to beat the endpoint-preserving permutation.
first_25.why_now: This directly tests information discarded by one-minute aggregation.

first_25.title: Veto demonstrably stale or incomplete inputs
first_25.what_runs: Replay 15-minute Nyström offers for all seven pairs. Compare no veto with all input ages at most 2 seconds, target coverage at least 891/900 seconds and consecutive bars; retain the two declared looser sensitivities. Match participation only inside validation; compare RV/clock random vetoes.
first_25.kill_rule: Skip negligible affected exposure; require 0.005 inner forward lift beyond matched exclusions and adequate support.
first_25.why_now: A timestamp-based failure can cheaply explain some confident-tail losses.

first_25.title: Smooth issued logits causally
first_25.what_runs: Replay 15-minute Nyström for all seven pairs with logit-EWMA half-lives 0, 2, 5, 15 minutes. Reset at session boundaries, gaps and disconnected blocks; exclude the same ten-minute warmup in controls. Select decay on three inner walks and recalibrate participation independently.
first_25.kill_rule: Kill below 0.005 mean matched-participation lift or fewer than two improving walks; favor no smoothing on ties.
first_25.why_now: This tests whether the tail is dominated by transient score noise.

first_25.title: Require consecutive same-side confidence
first_25.what_runs: Replay 15-minute Nyström for all seven pairs. Accept only when consecutive observed minutes choose the same side and both clear the frozen threshold. Compare the incumbent at validation-matched counts within 5%, with identical session resets and 15-minute de-overlap.
first_25.kill_rule: Kill unmatched counts, mean inner forward lift below 0.005 or two nonpositive walks.
first_25.why_now: A persistence requirement is a cheap final check before fitting richer models.

merged.why: These duplicate the contract-endpoint check. Retain one real-contract probe and put local maturity checks in E-007.
Both discount frozen moved-sign forecasts by learned exact-tie probability. Fit the combined tie-feature specification once.
Share the three-class target comparison; preserve freshness and five-bin ablations within the same bounded test.
Both test shared-parameter TabM against matched MLP controls. Use the smaller design and retain one embedding ablation.
Both compare gradient sampling with ordinary sampling. Include the full-row control in one matched-capacity experiment.

gaps.why: Checked on the EURUSD development dataset before placing it: the proposed difference exists only in the 1440-bar window.
gaps.narrowed_to: Recompute rv_1440m, rangepos_1440m and volratio_60_1440 on elapsed-minute windows and compare with the bar-count versions on Monday New York rows only; a prediction arm runs only if a default LightGBM or logistic fit moves by 0.005 inner tail win rate. owner_decisions.decision: Choose the campaign spending ceiling and release policy.
options: Release stages 1-4 first, capped at 20,700 fits and 6 GPU hours.
Release every bounded branch after its separate authorization.
Fund a smaller frozen menu instead of the comprehensive campaign.
owner_decisions.recommendation: Release stages 1-4 first. Release later stages only when their predeclared inner evidence or information prerequisite warrants the build.
owner_decisions.why: Build effort dominates many cheap fits. Comprehensive coverage should remain conditional rather than become an obligation to exhaust every low-prior branch.

owner_decisions.decision: Choose how to obtain the one-contract timestamp check and payout survey.
options: Supply an existing matched real-contract log.
Authorize one new real contract with an explicit monetary cap and a quote survey.
Defer venue access.
owner_decisions.recommendation: Use an existing matched log if available; otherwise authorize one bounded contract probe and a separate quote survey.
owner_decisions.why: The label convention is settled. Only actual proposal, acceptance and settlement timestamps can establish transport equivalence; prospective quotes do not reconstruct historical payouts.

owner_decisions.decision: Choose the relationship between formal certification and executable profitability.
options: Retain the 0.541 certificate and report actual quoted-payoff results separately.
Add a separately specified payout-qualified certificate.
Change contract type in a later versioned research scope.
owner_decisions.recommendation: Retain the stated certificate and require a separate executable-payoff assessment before deployment.
owner_decisions.why: A side passing 0.541 can still lose money at observed offers. A ties-win contract would change the target and requires its own specification.

owner_decisions.decision: Authorize additional horizon and expiry keys.

Add 60 minutes, then 120 and 240 minutes conditionally.
Also admit a separately certified NY 16:00 expiry.
owner_decisions.recommendation: Authorize 60 minutes after terms and schedule-only support checks. Admit longer or fixed-expiry keys only if those checks pass.

owner_decisions.decision: Choose which closed model families to reopen.
options: Reopen stronger shrinkage and bounded pooling only.
Also reopen the small tabular and temporal neural controls.
Authorize the complete bounded neural, representation and finite-race menu.
owner_decisions.recommendation: Start with stronger shrinkage and within-pair horizon sharing. Authorize small neural controls next; keep richer branches behind their stated parent gates.
owner_decisions.why: Previous closures remain negative evidence. Approval should name fixed recipes and budgets rather than permit an unrestricted architecture search.

owner_decisions.decision: Approve calendar repair and first-release macro archives separately.
options: Approve schedule repair only.
Also supply first actuals, consensus vintages and receipt history.
Defer macro inputs.
owner_decisions.recommendation: Repair schedules first if a causal archive is readily available. Add surprise content only with genuine first-release and receipt provenance.

owner_decisions.decision: Approve additional independently observed Deriv instruments.
options: Supply a fixed direct-cross panel.
Also supply fixed gold, oil and equity-index histories.
Defer additional instruments.

owner_decisions.decision: Approve one independent same-asset reference archive.
options: Supply receipt-timestamped spot quotes.
Supply futures with dated roll and carry conventions.
Defer reference-venue inputs.
owner_decisions.recommendation: Prefer one well-synchronized spot archive; reject arbitrary clock alignment or incomplete six-group coverage.
owner_decisions.why: An observable reference dislocation could add information. A historical lead created by clock correction or future-nearest joins cannot.

owner_decisions.decision: Approve authoritative execution flow or sequenced books.
options: Supply executions with actual size and authoritative aggressor side.
Supply sequenced books with completeness logs.
Defer both sources.
owner_decisions.recommendation: Prioritize one signed execution archive. Admit book tests separately only when reconstruction and availability are defensible.
owner_decisions.why: These observations are absent from midpoint ticks. Execution flow, signed book pressure and unsigned liquidity are distinct tests sharing source audits.

options: Supply availability-stamped rates or forwards.
Also supply short-dated FX option quotes and conventions.
Defer these inputs.
owner_decisions.recommendation: Use one compact source already retained with trustworthy timestamps; do not acquire a broad panel merely for coverage.
owner_decisions.why: Rate innovations and physical magnitude information require observed quotes, freshness and dated conventions. Their fields cannot be recovered from current spot prices.

owner_decisions.decision: Approve signed exposure and option-position ledgers.
options: Supply a documented intraday exposure ledger.
Supply signed option positions and opening-flow fields.
Defer exposure tests.

options: Authorize timestamp reconstruction and both bounded transfer contrasts.
Authorize magnitude transfer only.
Defer vendor transfer.

owner_decisions.decision: Approve first-received news and its extractor provenance.
options: Supply immutable first-seen text for the sparse response decoder.
Also approve one frozen sentiment extractor.
Defer text inputs.
owner_decisions.recommendation: Use a first-seen archive only if already retained. Start with counts and the sparse decoder before a more elaborate extractor.

owner_decisions.decision: Choose any slow or alternative external source before outcomes.
options: Use first-vintage weekly positioning or one fixed stress/funding block.
Use one identified prediction-market or alternative-activity archive.
Defer all such sources.
owner_decisions.recommendation: Prefer an existing first-vintage positioning or stress archive. Defer sparse prediction-market and alternative sources without adequate independent publication counts.

owner_decisions.decision: Approve exact external checkpoints and acceptable provenance uncertainty.
options: Admit one checkpoint with documented corpus and cutoff.
Admit unknown provenance only as an explicitly contaminated exploratory comparison.
Defer imported checkpoints.
owner_decisions.recommendation: Admit only documented local checkpoints for demonstrable comparisons; otherwise defer.
owner_decisions.why: Licensing, pretraining exposure and usable interfaces must be resolved before inference. Unknown development-period exposure cannot support independence claims.

owner_decisions.decision: Choose the permitted interpretation of adaptive evaluation.
options: Keep the original certificate and allow separate forward diagnostics.
Define and freeze a new adaptive-policy certificate.
Defer continuing-policy research.
owner_decisions.recommendation: Keep the original certificate and label continuing-policy runs as forward diagnostics unless a separate certification protocol is explicitly adopted.
owner_decisions.why: Using settled test feedback changes the deployed procedure. It cannot inherit a static per-fold-refit certificate without an explicit scope decision.

owner_decisions.decision: Set the full-search null replay ceiling.
options: Fund complete refits of every actually attempted branch after a raw survivor.
Freeze a much smaller campaign before execution.
Accept conditional cached inference without claiming complete refit correction.
owner_decisions.recommendation: Freeze manageable cohorts before execution and fund complete refits only when a raw survivor and adequate power justify them. Never null-test only an outcome-selected shortlist.
owner_decisions.why: The exhaustive upper bound exceeds 21 million null fits and 122,000 GPU hours. Actual cost can be far lower after prerequisite failures, but a cheap shortlist replay answers a different question.

claim_dispositions.claim: The RV feature units must support the proposed square-root-of-horizon normalization.
claim_dispositions.evidence: tools/deriv_dataset.py lines 94 and 102: r1 = lc.diff() is the log-close change of one one-minute bar and rv_w = r1.rolling(w, min_periods=max(5, w // 3)).std(), so rv_w is a per-minute standard deviation in log-return units and ret_w / (sqrt(w) * rv_60m) is dimensionless. The dataset's own stretch_w (line 109) already divides by r1.rolling(w).std() * np.sqrt(w). ret_w is a wall-clock return and rv_w counts bars; they agree where bars are contiguous (99.984% of EURUSD development bars).
claim_dispositions.consequence: A-056 can use the normalization as written. It must not use the 1440-bar scale on Mondays without the R6-GAP-01 correction.

claim_dispositions.claim: The installed CatBoost Ordered configuration must honor the intended chronological history.
claim_dispositions.evidence: Lab test x-r6-libcheck (discovery/round6/checks/library_behaviour_fixture.py and .log), CatBoost 1.2.10: Ordered with has_time=True resolves to permutation_count=1, without it to 4. With all other randomness off, two seeds give identical test probabilities with has_time=True (largest difference 0) and differ by up to 4.99e-02 without it. Reversing the row order changes the Ordered has_time model by up to 1.22e-01 and a Plain model by 2.2e-16.
claim_dispositions.consequence: A-032 must pass rows sorted by decision time and set has_time=True; the default Ordered mode draws four random permutations and is not chronological. Label overlap between neighbouring rows is not handled by the library, so the H-non-overlapping fit origins in the specification are required.

summary: Every cluster is accounted for exactly once: 282 planned procedures, seven absorptions and 27 not run, including all 26 rejections. The gaps file remained absent. Work was read-only and offline. Stage numbers give spending priority; owner-gated branches additionally require their listed decisions. Budgets are conditional ceilings including controls and inner fits, not forecasts of required expenditure. Except where the first 25 or cluster specifies otherwise, begin with EURUSD, USDCAD and USDCHF at 15 minutes on three chronological inner walks. Repeat every efficacy screen, recipe choice and final selection inside outer training; expand survivors to all seven pairs and separately registered 30-minute tasks. Balanced three-path pilots never certify. All feature and outcome dependencies must remain within permitted development data. The early opportunity is better use of rows and side participation, followed by raw paths and pending peer adjustments. Most later model, loss, ensemble and magnitude tests are expected null. For a non-USDJPY side to pass credibly, a conditional signed effect must persist across calendar groups, survive ties and participation controls, support at least 25 trades on 12 paths, and withstand selection correction. My subjective probability of at least one credible non-USDJPY 15/30-minute pass on this fixed history is about 8%, with a judgment range of 3-15%; 15 minutes alone is closer to 3-5%. Longer executable horizons could raise the combined chance modestly, subject to support. A raw rule pass after this much searching is substantially more likely than a demonstrable finding. The single change I would prioritize to raise the odds is a genuine signed-execution-flow archive, timestamped as received and aligned to Deriv, because it adds directional observations unavailable in midpoint-price repackaging.
